gate.rationale: Proposed source-free Phase 2 consolidation for the independent reconstruction-v2-independent corpus only. At the exact pinned inventory and unresolved fingerprint, all 659 original formulations have complete classification scans and zero unassigned or ambiguous reference occurrences. The 727 raw missing-candidate identities have been reduced by reviewed historical alias and resolution history to 418 currently unresolved canonical contextual identities covering 841 effective missing occurrences; they remain explicit independent missing candidates, not 418 asserted new source-certified mathematical definitions. The 40 historical convention/component cases, 73 effective occurrences across 72 parent visits, source type/size repairs, and nine high-reuse negative comparisons (187 occurrences) are documented in PHASE2_EXIT_DOSSIER.md, HIGH_IMPACT_EXISTING_MATCH_REVIEW.md, the approved typed-component policy and PHASE2_CONSOLIDATION_DECISION_PROPOSAL.md. Already-applied generic category, ordinary groupoid, limit/colimit and historical seed corrections must not be repeated. The current compactness closed-FIP formulation expressly quantifies nonempty closed-set families, so the old empty-family warning is inapplicable to the live source. Six exact un-applied source wording/convention proposals, partial provider checks at ranks 133/166/175, six candidate-context overlay leads, the bounded rank-298 explanatory occurrence, specialized self-link exclusions, and four provisional source issues are explicitly tracked and held for their own future provenance-preserving corrections/release checks; none is silently certified, merged or published by this classification decision. This proposed gate is only a transition to a version-guarded bounded first-generation missing-definition research milestone, not a mathematical/source certification, production comparison, freeze or deployment approval. Submission requires an explicit independent owner/reviewer authorization and immediate revalidation of hashes, exact effective events and the full contract.
